headline.text: L3 ML1 fought belt jams, clogged nozzles, and piston faults overnight — team stopped depositing at *04:57* and began flushing after 10 operators sent home.

per_plant_summary.L1: S2 completed planned changeover and cleaning for Monday belt replacement at 21:20; C&E confirmed onsite 07:30.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 mold cooler filters were pulled for cleaning at 15:42 and need reinstallation before the line can run.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 had cascading equipment failures through the night — belt jams cleared by 00:38, but clogged nozzles and piston faults forced the team to call depositing and start flushing at 04:57. Truffle line belt replacement completed successfully at 05:44.

notes.text: S2 enrober belt replacement scheduled Monday 07:30 with C&E; new gearbox staged at maintenance shop.

resolved.title: M110 belt jammed and replaced
resolved.summary: Belt had frays and jammed at 22:50, stopping the line; maintenance replaced the belt and verified it running properly by 00:38.
resolved.resolution: Belt replaced and tested running at 00:38 — "Running the M110 the belt to make sure it's running properly" (Raoul Lubain).

resolved.title: Truffle line final product conveyor belt replaced
resolved.summary: Broken conveyor belt was replaced overnight; visual inspection at 05:44 confirmed good condition and correct operation.
resolved.resolution: Replacement completed and verified at 05:44 — "visual check...confirms that it is in good condition and operating correctly" (Janeth Sanchez).

needs_attention.title: ML2 mold cooler filters out for drying
needs_attention.summary: Filters were washed and pulled from the mold cooler at 15:42; they need to finish drying and be reinstalled before the line can run.
needs_attention.status: Filters drying as of 15:43; Alan Todd asked Alex Mendoza to ensure reinstallation, no follow-up in window.

needs_attention.title: ML1 depositing stopped after cascading equipment failures
needs_attention.summary: Clogged nozzles at 01:22 led to block wash and dosing head pulls; right piston faulted three times at 04:31; team stopped depositing at 04:57, sent 10 operators home, and began flushing.
needs_attention.status: Depositing stopped at 04:57; buffer tank emptied by 06:12, oil flush started at 06:31, chocolate emptied by 06:46.
